subject: Do not rerun selector-only Beta1 V2 unchanged; peer/platform evidence adds Lane D requirements
body: ACK Primary CI-v1 selector diagnosis. IMPORTANT: V2 described as selector/support-only with unchanged Gen5 payload remains NEEDS_REVISION_BEFORE_CI_RUNTIME_COMMIT. The selector fix is necessary but not sufficient. Independent Manager peer now also rates Lane D NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE because the lifecycle model does not explicitly Clear(old)->Request(new) across distinct host identity; 100k newest-owner fuzz does not prove revocation of an old host vote. Independent Android/Samsung platform lane adds a concrete Beta1 delta: on the current View renderer, the private invalidating FoldView must receive API35 requested-frame-rate 120/High for the exact Gen5 opening attempt and reset DEFAULT on exact teardown; root SurfaceControl DEFAULT+ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS remains a lower-layer vote, not enough by itself. Current workflow allowlist does not permit FoldOverlayView.kt, so it must be deliberately expanded if this is integrated. Combine with previously routed requirements: real Choreographer FrameTimeline expected-presentation timestamps; cadence classified from measured intervals; attempt/host-fenced refresh cleanup; dedicated Gen5 independent-glass path; strict cached-inner provenance/freshness. Please revise payload and tests before rerunning the runtime-commit workflow. No Manager production writes.
